card.name: Counts of patients, times, trials
card.fires_on: Digits inside a number or the counting noun right after a number, such as patients, times, trials or spacewalks. It appears in study results and in statistics about events.

modes.label: Inside a number
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a multi-digit count of patients or participants.
modes.example: and in 71<<4>> patients with a biopsy only during treatment.

modes.label: Noun after a count
modes.description: The counted thing right after a number, such as times, patients or trials.
modes.example: Bourne has staged Onegin roughly 25<< times>> in 35 years.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a number is being counted out, such as how many patients, trials or times something happened.
